  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provide extra bedding like straw or hay.

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Protect animals from wind and moisture using windbreaks or tarps.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Keep animals hydrated with unfrozen water.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Vaccinate and deworm animals during winter.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Monitor for frostbite on animals.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Prepare a winter emergency kit with essential items.
